verdict.rationale: TrueLayer emits JSON webhooks on Payments API v3 events, such as payment status changes, sent to a single configured URI per app. Users can wire those events to their own logic, and authorised mandates let payments execute without further user action. Console also lets users configure sweeping of merchant balances, a limited rule-like automation. There is no evidence of a native rules engine where users define event-to-action conditions; automation must be built in user code on top of webhooks. Missing for 10: a first-party rules/automation builder, documented condition-to-action configuration beyond sweeping, any independent or hands-on corroboration.
